snippet.title: Aurion: Legacy of The Kori-Odan | a nice 2D RPG on Xbox | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Discover Aurion, Legacy of the Kori-Odan  on Xbox here 👉👉https://urlr.me/kzjrp

Play as the exiled king and queen of Zama. Travel and gather your aurionic powers to build a world where everyone understands each other despite their differences. You'll have to fight and find your answers against centuries of hatred and selfishness.

Aurion is the energy that links the desires of all living beings.
Aurionics are those who channel Aurion to shape the world in their own image.
An existential war is waging between all the Aurionics who covet this supreme power: the future of humanity depends on it!

GAMEPLAY :
* 2D hand-drawn graphics
* Real-time combat on the ground and in the air.
* Powerful duels with immersive combat dialogues.
* Unlock 21 Aurionics stage with 66 skills (some available on the ground and in the air).
* A cliché-free story: no good versus evil, no prophecy, no chosen one, etc.
* 15 hours of play.
